description: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the distribution of participant responses across several criteria related to a claim retrieval system. The vertical axis displays the evaluation criteria—Relevant FCs, FC Summary, Relevance Explanation, Clarity and Simplicity, Overall Summary, Filters, Veracity Explanation—listed in that order from top to bottom. The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of Participants,” represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at intervals of 2. Each criterion is represented by a single, solid-colored bar; the bars are arranged in descending order based on the number of participants. The “Relevant FCs” criterion has the longest bar, extending to a value of approximately 6, while “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” each have the shortest bars, both reaching a value of 1. The bars for “FC Summary,” “Relevance Explanation,” and “Clarity and Simplicity” have lengths of approximately 5, 3, and 3, respectively, and the “Overall Summary” bar extends to a value of 2. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
